Every model medfit can run, in one place. Find yours in the first table, then
open its page. For a one-page lookup of every function see the
[Reference Card](refcard.html); for short task recipes see the
[Cookbook](cookbook.html).

## Find your model

| I have | Page |
|---|---|
| One mediator, a continuous outcome | [Simple mediation](model-simple.html) |
| A binary or count outcome, or a binary mediator | [Binary and non-normal variables](model-glm-families.html) |
| An effect of the mediator that depends on the treatment | [Treatment-by-mediator interaction](model-interaction.html) |
| Inverse-probability weights or case weights | [Weights and robust SEs](model-weights.html) |
| The closed-form regression engine | [The regmedint engine](model-regmedint.html) |
| Mediators in a chain (M1 drives M2) | [Serial mediation](model-serial.html) |
| Mediators side by side | [Parallel mediation](model-parallel.html) |
| Several mediators and treatment-by-mediator products | [Joint mediation](model-joint.html) |
| Treatment assigned to whole clusters | [Cookbook recipe 9](cookbook.html#cluster-randomized-trial) |
| A lavaan fit | [Cookbook recipe 10](cookbook.html#i-use-lavaan) |
| A latent mediator, constraints, or syntax | [Cookbook recipe 11](cookbook.html#a-latent-mediator-native-engine) |

## Capabilities at a glance

| Model | Class | Engines and routes | Standard errors | Page |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Simple | `MediationData` | `glm`, `regmedint`, `extract_mediation()` (`lm`/`glm`, lavaan), native | model, sandwich | [simple](model-simple.html) |
| Binary or count variables | `MediationData` | `glm` families | model, sandwich | [glm families](model-glm-families.html) |
| Treatment-by-mediator | `InteractionMediationData` | `glm`, `regmedint`, lavaan | model; closed form (`regmedint`) | [interaction](model-interaction.html) |
| Weighted | `MediationData` | `glm`; native `sampling_weights` | sandwich (HC3; native HC0-type) | [weights](model-weights.html) |
| Serial | `SerialMediationData` | `lm`/`glm` with `mediator_models`, lavaan, native via `fit_sem()` | model | [serial](model-serial.html) |
| Parallel | `ParallelMediationData` | `lm`/`glm`, lavaan, native via `fit_sem()` | model | [parallel](model-parallel.html) |
| Joint, with products | `JointMediationData` | `lm` fits | delta method, bootstrap | [joint](model-joint.html) |
| Cluster-level treatment (2-1-1) | `ClusterMediationData` | `lmer` fits or `engine = "lmer"` | model, Kenward-Roger (`"kr"`) | [recipe 9](cookbook.html#cluster-randomized-trial) |
| Latent mediator, constraints | `SEMFit`, then extracted | `fit_sem()`, `engine = "native"` (experimental) | model, sandwich | [recipe 11](cookbook.html#a-latent-mediator-native-engine) |

Inference works on every row: delta-method intervals from `tidy()` and
`confint()`, and the parametric, nonparametric and plugin bootstrap (see
[Bootstrap Inference](bootstrap.html)).

::: {.callout-note}
## The native engine takes one mediator in `fit_mediation()`
`fit_mediation(engine = "native", model = )` accepts a single mediator. For
several mediators, fit the syntax with `fit_sem()` and then call
`extract_mediation(fit, mediator = c(...), outcome = )`, with
`structure = "parallel"` for side-by-side mediators.
:::

## What medfit does not run

- Treatment varying within clusters (1-1-1), and non-Gaussian outcomes or
  mediators in the cluster design.
- Four-way or joint decompositions with non-Gaussian models.
- Mean structures, and the four-way decomposition, on the native engine.
- Bayesian fits through `brms` (planned).

See [Methods and Formulas](methods.html) for the assumptions behind each model.
